description: The PATIENTS table contains demographic and mortality information for each patient in the dataset. It includes the patient's gender, date of birth, and multiple date of death records from different sources (hospital, social security, and a general patient table record), as well as an expire flag indicating patient mortality. The table uses `SUBJECT_ID` as a unique patient identifier.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: The gender of the patient, either 'F' (female) or 'M' (male).

columns.name: DOD
columns.description: The patient's date of death, if available.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: The patient's date of death recorded during hospitalization, if available.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: The patient's date of death as recorded by the Social Security Administration, if available.

columns.name: EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the patient has expired (1) or not (0).
